say:3:1521304002:1.female: I didn't mean to bother you. I-I'm Marco. I'm stationed here in Mirehold.

say:4:1521304003:0.female: I know two Wildborn youths whose parents are in Wrathwood Grove, but they've been trapped here since the war.

choice_prompt:6:1521304004.female: I was hoping you could take them away and send them home.

say:8:1521304008:0.source_cn: 在你们答应帮忙之前，我绝对不会透露他们的信息。万一其他...

choice:6:1:2.female: Why would a Halian help them?

say:20:1521304006:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> needs to know more about the two Wildborn youths.

say:20:1521304006:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> needs to know more about the two Wildborn youths.

say:0:1521305001:0.source_cn: 跟我来。不要发出太大的声响。

say:3:1521306002:0.source_cn: 没事，我可以帮你们引开他们。

say:4:1521306003:0.text: When the time comes, go directly into the camp and head up to the <style="highlight">highest platform</style>. <style="highlight">Find a girl named Fufu</style>. She's about twenty years old.
say:4:1521306003:0.source_cn: 到时候你们就直接进入营地，到<style=highli...

say:5:1521306004:0.text: If you can't find her or where to go, don't worry. I'll meet up with you later.
say:5:1521306004:0.source_cn: 找不到也没关系，我稍后就会过去和你们汇合的。

narration:6:1521306005:1.text: Marco walks right up to the guards and strikes up a conversation. Before long, they leave together.

say:0:1521307001:0.text: We need to sneak into the camp.
say:0:1521307001:0.source_cn: 抓紧时间，绕进营地里吧。
say:0:1521307001:0.male: We need to sneak into the camp.
say:0:1521307001:0.female: We need to sneak into the camp.

narration:0:1521308001:1.text: You climb over the barricades and step into Mirehold.

say:0:1521309001:0.text: I don't see anyone who could be Fufu. Should we ask the children over there?
say:0:1521309001:0.source_cn: 好像没有可能是芙的人。要不要问问前面的孩子？
say:0:1521309001:0.male: I don't see anyone who could be Fufu. Should we ask the children over there?
say:0:1521309001:0.female: I don't see anyone who could be Fufu. Should we ask the children over there?

say:2:1521310002:0.text: Why is a Halian here so late at night?!
say:2:1521310002:0.source_cn: 又是个呼临人……为什么这么晚了呼临人还会到营地里来？！

say:4:1521310003:0.text: Don't be rude. This is Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Every Wildborn should know him by now.
say:4:1521310003:0.male: Don't be rude. This is Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Every Wildborn should know him by now.
say:4:1521310003:0.female: Don't be rude. This is Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Every Wildborn should know her by now.

say:6:1521310005:1.text: Fufu! Help! There's a stranger here!
say:6:1521310005:1.source_cn: 姐姐——姐姐！有奇怪的人，快来救救我！
say:6:1521310005:1.male: Fufu! Help! There's a stranger here!
say:6:1521310005:1.female: Fufu! Help! There's a stranger here!

say:2:1521312002:0.text: You must be here to rescue me and Twitch! I can't believe he really managed to get you here!
say:2:1521312002:0.source_cn: 你是来救我和扭耳离开的，对吗？他真的把你请来了！
say:2:1521312002:0.male: You must be here to rescue me and Twitch! I can't believe he really managed to get you here!
say:2:1521312002:0.female: You must be here to rescue me and Twitch! I can't believe he really managed to get you here!

say:4:1521312003:0.text: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...
say:4:1521312003:0.source_cn: 啊？他们是那个呼临人找来的帮手？呃……看起来一点也不可靠！
say:4:1521312003:0.male: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...
say:4:1521312003:0.female: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...

choice_prompt:5:1521312003.text: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...
choice_prompt:5:1521312003.source_cn: 啊？他们是那个呼临人找来的帮手？呃……看起来一点也不可靠！
choice_prompt:5:1521312003.male: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...
choice_prompt:5:1521312003.female: That Halian convinced them to help us? Uh... They don't seem so reliable...

say:7:1521312005:1.text: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.
say:7:1521312005:1.male: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.
say:7:1521312005:1.female: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.

say:8:1521312006:0.text: By the way, is Marco okay?
say:8:1521312006:0.source_cn: 对了，马尔科他……他没来吗？

say:10:1521312007:0.text: He went to distract the guards and will be here later.
say:10:1521312007:0.source_cn: 他去引开守卫了，一会会过来。

say:12:1521312009:1.text: He told us that your parents are at Wrathwood Grove, but you two are trapped here. What happened?
say:12:1521312009:1.source_cn: 他说，你们的父母在树怒山谷，但你们被困在这里。为什么会这样？

say:13:1521312010:0.text: Our family originally lived here, but when the Halians attacked, my parents went to fight back. Soon, we lost contact with them.
say:13:1521312010:0.source_cn: 我们一家原本都生活在这里。但呼临人进攻的时候，阿爹阿娘...

say:14:1521312011:0.text: Although Marco has been nice to us, I'm still worried about my parents.
say:14:1521312011:0.source_cn: 呼临人……马尔科虽然没有刁难我和扭耳，可我还是很担心阿...

say:15:1521312012:1.text: I've been quietly asking around and finally got news that they were injured on the battlefield. <style="highlight">They're currently healing in Wrathwood Grove.</style>
say:15:1521312012:1.source_cn: 我一直找人悄悄打听，好不容易才得到了消息。他们在战场上...

say:16:1521312013:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!
say:16:1521312013:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!
say:16:1521312013:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!

say:17:1521312014:0.text: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!
say:17:1521312014:0.male: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!
say:17:1521312014:0.female: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!

say:21:1521312016:0.text: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.
say:21:1521312016:0.source_cn: 是，一切都听从你的命令。
say:21:1521312016:0.male: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.
say:21:1521312016:0.female: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.

choice:5:0:1.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.
choice:5:0:1.male: Don't judge a book by its cover.
choice:5:0:1.female: Don't judge a book by its cover.

choice:5:2:3.text: Do you want me to help you or not?
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 小心惹我生气之后就不帮你们了
choice:5:2:3.male: Do you want me to help you or not?
choice:5:2:3.female: Do you want me to help you or not?

say:2:1521314001:0.text: Marco, you're back! Are you hurt?
say:2:1521314001:0.source_cn: 马尔科，你回来了！有没有哪里受伤？

say:3:1521314002:0.source_cn: 我好着呢。没事的，芙，不用担心。

say:4:1521314003:0.text: Why do you have so much blood on your hand?
say:4:1521314003:0.source_cn: 那你的手掌怎么蹭破了？还流了这么多血？

say:5:1521314004:0.text: Oh, that... It's just a scratch I got from climbing over the barricades. It's not serious.
say:5:1521314004:0.source_cn: 啊，那个……那是翻越拒马时一不小心蹭到的，不碍事。

say:6:1521314005:0.text: It doesn't hurt at all. I didn't even notice until you said something.
say:6:1521314005:0.source_cn: 你看，一点都不疼！你不说我都没感觉到。

say:7:1521314006:0.text: Come inside later. I'll apply a salve.
say:7:1521314006:0.source_cn: 待会到屋里来，我为你敷药。

say:16:1521314011:0.text: Fufu, we still haven't decided on how we're going to leave.
say:16:1521314011:0.source_cn: 姐姐，我们还没定好要怎么离开呢！

say:18:1521314013:0.text: Twitch is right. Let's talk about our plan first.
say:18:1521314013:0.source_cn: 扭、扭耳说的没错。还是先商讨一下送你们离开的计划吧。

say:20:1521314014:0.text: <style="highlight">Tomorrow evening</style> will be my turn to guard the main gate. I can find a way to get rid of the other guards. Then, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> can lead everyone out.
say:20:1521314014:0.male: <style="highlight">Tomorrow evening</style> will be my turn to guard the main gate. I can find a way to get rid of the other guards. Then, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> can lead everyone out.
say:20:1521314014:0.female: <style="highlight">Tomorrow evening</style> will be my turn to guard the main gate. I can find a way to get rid of the other guards. Then, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> can lead everyone out.

say:21:1521314015:0.text: What do you think? The plan is okay, right?
say:21:1521314015:0.source_cn: 怎么样，这个计划可行吗？
say:21:1521314015:0.male: What do you think? The plan is okay, right?
say:21:1521314015:0.female: What do you think? The plan is okay, right?

choice_prompt:22:1521314015.source_cn: 怎么样，这个计划可行吗？
choice_prompt:22:1521314015.male: What do you think? The plan is okay, right?
choice_prompt:22:1521314015.female: What do you think? The plan is okay, right?

say:23:1521314016:0.text: Okay, let's do it this way then. Thanks for your help.
say:23:1521314016:0.source_cn: 好，那就这样办。谢谢您的帮助。
say:23:1521314016:0.male: Okay, let's do it this way then. Thanks for your help.
say:23:1521314016:0.female: Okay, let's do it this way then. Thanks for your help.

say:24:1521314017:0.text: Fufu, Twitch... Please be extra careful when the time comes.
say:24:1521314017:0.source_cn: 芙，扭耳……到时你们一定要多加小心。

say:26:1521314018:0.text: We will. You take care of yourself too.

say:27:1521314019:0.text: You don't need to worry about me.

narration:28:1521314020:0.text: The following evening, you and Gala arrive at the meeting spot.
narration:28:1521314020:0.source_cn: 第二天晚上，你和加拉来到了约定好的地点

choice:22:1:2.text: You know the guards. You decide.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 你了解守卫的情况，你说了算
choice:22:1:2.male: You know the guards. You decide.
choice:22:1:2.female: You know the guards. You decide.

choice:12:0:1.text: You don't need to know right now.
choice:12:0:1.male: You don't need to know right now.
choice:12:0:1.female: You don't need to know right now.

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 呼临人和雅库伯尔人？不会吧……

say:32:1521314009:0.source_cn: 加拉不太明白您说的话……

choice:9:2:3.text: We seem to be third wheels.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 我们三个好像有点碍事
choice:9:2:3.male: We seem to be third wheels.
choice:9:2:3.female: We seem to be third wheels.

say:2:1521315001:0.text: Please forgive me... Just thinking about leaving this place and finally being able to see my parents is getting me a little excited...
say:2:1521315001:0.source_cn: 请原谅我……一想到马上就要离开这里，去找阿爹阿娘了，我...

say:3:1521315002:0.text: It's too early for that, Fufu. Look at all the Halians in camp today. We have to be extra careful.
say:3:1521315002:0.source_cn: 姐姐，现在激动太早了。今天营地里的呼临人好像变多了，我...

say:5:1521315004:0.text: We'll be able to escape today, right...?
say:5:1521315004:0.source_cn: 我们一定能逃出去的，对吗？
say:5:1521315004:0.male: We'll be able to escape today, right...?
say:5:1521315004:0.female: We'll be able to escape today, right...?

choice_prompt:6:1521315004.text: We'll be able to escape today, right...?
choice_prompt:6:1521315004.source_cn: 我们一定能逃出去的，对吗？
choice_prompt:6:1521315004.male: We'll be able to escape today, right...?
choice_prompt:6:1521315004.female: We'll be able to escape today, right...?

say:7:1521315005:1.text: Yes, both Twitch and I leave our lives in your hands, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:7:1521315005:1.male: Yes, both Twitch and I leave our lives in your hands, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:7:1521315005:1.female: Yes, both Twitch and I leave our lives in your hands, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:8:1521315006:0.text: We'll be right behind you. <style="highlight">Please help us escape Mirehold.</style>
say:8:1521315006:0.male: We'll be right behind you. <style="highlight">Please help us escape Mirehold.</style>
say:8:1521315006:0.female: We'll be right behind you. <style="highlight">Please help us escape Mirehold.</style>

choice:6:0:1.text: Don't be scared and stay close to me.
choice:6:0:1.male: Don't be scared and stay close to me.
choice:6:0:1.female: Don't be scared and stay close to me.

choice:6:2:3.text: I'll show you what I can do.
choice:6:2:3.male: I'll show you what I can do.
choice:6:2:3.female: I'll show you what I can do.

say:3:1521320002:0.text: Luckily, it's a minor injury. I can explain it later.
say:3:1521320002:0.source_cn: 呼，还好……这点伤我还解释得过去。

choice_prompt:4:1521320002.text: Luckily, it's a minor injury. I can explain it later.
choice_prompt:4:1521320002.source_cn: 呼，还好……这点伤我还解释得过去。

say:2:1521322001:0.text: Marco, I hope you know I have feelings for you...
say:2:1521322001:0.source_cn: 马尔科，你……你知道我对你的心，对吗？

say:4:1521322003:0.text: I feel the same way about you.

say:5:1521322004:0.source_cn: 我们……我们还会再见面吗？

say:6:1521322005:0.text: Of course, we will definitely meet again! The moment I can slip away, I'll come find you.
say:6:1521322005:0.source_cn: 会的……一定会的！只要有机会，我一定会去见你……
